title: Operations Kill-Switch AppConfig Document 1.0
description: The single deployment-wide operations kill-switch document. It is self-contained and usable directly as an AWS AppConfig JSON Schema validator: every $ref is a local #/$defs fragment (no external/urn reference to resolve), it is a closed object with no unknown fields, and it enumerates exactly the deployment-wide operations_enabled flag plus the single gamelift.capacity-adjustment capability's prepare/dispatch/execute phase booleans, an immutable monotonic config version, and issued_at/not_after freshness. Timestamps are the normalized UTC Z form so lexicographic order equals chronological order. It carries no identity, credential, policy, principal, or provider payload. The default safe document disables everything.

config_version.description: Immutable monotonic version of this kill-switch document. A consumer binds a control to an exact config_version so a stale write cannot silently re-enable a phase.

not_after.description: Freshness horizon. A consumer treats the document as stale (and fails closed) once the current time is at or after not_after.

operations_enabled.description: The deployment-wide master switch. When false, every capability and every phase is disabled regardless of the per-capability booleans.

capabilities.description: Exactly the one supported capability. No unknown capability may appear.

contract_version.description: Inlined copy of the immutable common contract_version so this document validates directly under AWS AppConfig with no external reference. It is identical to urn:game-agent:operations:contracts:v1:common#/$defs/contract_version.

utc_timestamp.description: A normalized UTC instant in RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 form with a literal uppercase 'Z' zone and optional fractional seconds: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss(.sss)Z. Requiring the Z form (never a numeric offset such as +00:00, never a naive local time) guarantees that lexicographic string order equals chronological order, so consumers cannot be tricked by an offset representation. This is a tightening of the common date-time timestamp for this AppConfig document.

capability_phase_switches.description: The three ordered lifecycle phase booleans for the capability. Enabling a later phase requires the earlier phase to be enabled; that ordering invariant is enforced semantically, not structurally.
